children: ESSENTIAL PROPERTIES REALTY TRUST, INC. reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $168.7M, up 16.4% from $144.9M a year earlier, while net income attributable to stockholders was $60.16M versus $65.62M in 3Q 2025, a decline of (8.3%). Diluted earnings per share for the quarter were not reported in Part I Items 1–2 of the filing.
Revenue: $168.7M for 3Q 2026, compared with $144.9M in 3Q 2025; YoY change 16.4%.
Net income: $60.16M attributable to stockholders for 3Q 2026, compared with $65.62M in 3Q 2025; YoY change (8.3%).
Diluted earnings per share: Not reported for the quarter in Part I Items 1–2 and therefore omitted.
Rental revenue grew about 18% year-to-date, driven by portfolio expansion to 2,580 properties and high occupancy at 99.6%.
Sale‑leasebacks remain the primary origination channel, comprising 92% of recent investments.
Portfolio diversification spans 727 concepts across 49 states; the largest tenant represents under 3% of ABR, reducing concentration risk.
Leases are long-term, triple-net with an average remaining term of 14.2 years and approximately 97% of leases include rent escalation averaging ~1.9% per year.
Underwriting and asset monitoring are emphasized: unit-level rent coverage about 3.5x and required tenant financial reporting on roughly 99% of ABR.
